subject: Non-learning snapshot & geo-shepherding plan for pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valorahealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@valorahealth.com
Date: Sun, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: non-learning evidence + APAC residency for pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking Valora through the pilot conversation last week. Procurement has a handful of gating asks before we can move to a PO:

1) Non-learning / no-train: Can Redwood commit contractually that Valora customer data used in the pilot will not be used to improve Redwood models? If yes, we need a proposed contractual clause and an example attestation we can include in our DPA.

2) Evidence pack: For our security review we need a short ops/evidence pack that includes (a) subprocessor manifest for services that will touch the data, (b) example audit log excerpt showing export/activity, (c) retention and deletion steps for captured interactions, and (d) a sample of the telemetry/redaction policy.

3) Residency / KMS: We operate in APAC and preference is onshore key residency (APAC KMS or HSM). If onshore KMS is not available, we need a clear geo-routing plan and a list of subprocessors/regions that data may transit through.

4) Escrow / escrow snapshot: Our legal team would like a short note on whether you can provide an escrow snapshot or otherwise guarantee derivative control (we call this an "evidence snapshot") that shows model-improvement pipelines are disabled for our tenant.

Can you confirm whether these are feasible and provide a timeline? We are aiming to complete procurement review by May 30.

I've attached the DPA redline from our side (high level). Happy to take a 30m call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Lead, Valora Health
liam.oconnor@valorahealth.com
[Attachment: valora_dpa_redline_v1.pdf]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valorahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: non-learning evidence + APAC residency for pilot

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the timeline. Quick reply with a proposed plan and next steps; I'll follow up with concrete artifacts by the dates below.

High-level answers:
- Contract/no-train: Yes — we can commit to a scoped no-training (no model improvement) configuration for pilot tenants. We'll propose a short DPA addendum clause and an operational attestation template.
- Evidence pack: We can assemble an ops evidence pack that includes subprocessor manifest, a 7-day audit log excerpt, retention/deletion description, and a redaction/telemetry summary.
- KMS/residency: We offer a regional KMS routing option for APAC (managed KMS in APAC clouds) and can discuss a dedicated HSM path for enterprise pilots; I'll flag infra for a sizing/cost estimate.
- Escrow/snapshot: We can produce an "evidence snapshot" — an ops artifact and signed attestation showing model-update pipelines dormant for the pilot tenant, plus a short export path (SFTP) if you require custody.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 21 May: 30m discovery call to confirm scope (I propose 10:00 PT / 01:00 UTC).
- Fri 23 May: Draft DPA addendum + attestation template to you.
- Tue 27 May: Ops evidence pack (audit excerpt, subprocessor list, retention steps).

Action items on our side: Kim will prepare the ops checklist and assemble the logs; Marissa will coordinate pricing/PO constraints for KMS/HSM options. I will attach our initial redline back to you in this thread.

Would a Wed call work? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite.

- Markus
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_dpa_markus_v1.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: non-learning evidence + APAC residency for pilot

Markus / Marissa —

I'll own the ops evidence pack. Draft scope below (I'll produce files for each bullet):

- Subprocessor manifest (logical map + regions) — including cloud infra, logging, and monitoring vendors.
- Audit log excerpt (7-day slice) — sanitized example showing request IDs, timestamps, and export events.
- Retention & deletion flow — how we mark and purge tenant interactions (SLA for deletion).
- Telemetry & redaction policy — what we capture, what we redact, and ephemeral KV behavior.
- Evidence snapshot attestation — signed statement from Security that the pilot tenant will be on a non-learning configuration and model-updates are disabled.

Ops asks: infra to provide a short doc for APAC KMS routing (latency/costs), and for Product to confirm whether ephemeral KV will be used for the pilot (expected yes).

I've started a checklist and uploaded it to the deal folder (ops_evidence_checklist.xlsx). I will need the HubSpot deal id and a contact at procurement for DocuSign routing.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valorahealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@valorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: non-learning evidence + APAC residency for pilot

Thanks Markus — and thanks Kim for jumping in. Wed 21 call would have worked but we had an internal reschedule; can we instead do Friday 24 at 09:00 AET / 23:00 UTC? If not, next week is OK.

A couple of clarifying asks for procurement's checklist so we can keep the PO date:

- Deliverables we need before procurement can greenlight the PO: signed DPA addendum with the no-training clause, subprocessor manifest with locales, and one sample (sanitized) audit log excerpt. If you can provide those by Fri 30 May we can keep our timeline.
- On KMS: if APAC-managed KMS is available, we prefer that path; please include estimated monthly cost delta vs standard routing.
- DocuSign & procurement contacts: please send the DocuSign routing contact and a contact email so we can add them to our SRM.

If you can get the draft addendum and the manifest into the HubSpot deal folder, we'll mark it for legal review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam
Procurement Lead, Valora Health
[Attachment: procurement_checklist_valora.pdf]
